result.panel_note: Left is the untouched original crop. Right is an exact color-distance mask: magenta outlines candidate bands; blue marks only actual support at the peak coordinate. Marks are coordinate references, not entities. Right-panel local coordinates correspond to the same original crop after removing its combined-image offset.
result.evidence_note: Support intervals are measured only at each candidate peak. They do not prove a whole band is continuous or identify a wall. Filtered or empty results do not prove an object is absent.
result.display_note: For a returned-image point (rx, ry), first multiply by original_pixels_per_returned_pixel to obtain full combined-image coordinates (fx, fy). On the left, original image coordinates are (box_left + fx, box_top + fy). On the right, subtract mask_panel_combined_pixels[0] from fx before adding box_left. Prefer candidates and support intervals, which already use original-image coordinates.

data.scope: agent-supplied geometry to independent source BIM; no correction run or solver stage

source_geometry_self_consistency.scope: source geometry, contacts and explicit opening hosts

agent_assumptions: Wall representative plane = measured pixel line centrelines/outer faces from pixel_profile scans, not nominal 240mm offsets.
Window/door heights: North window sill1.0/head3.4m, South windows sill1.0/head2.8m (directly measured). East/West window heights assumed equal to North pattern (sill1.0/head3.4m).
All doors assumed 2.4m height, base 0 (floor level).
Building height 4.5m used uniformly for the single floor per all four elevations.

The corridor (north-south spine) and the south-east furniture area merge into ONE physical room: no full-height wall separates them in the pixel evidence (a short non-connecting wall fragment near x440-560,y698 was omitted since it cannot close a separate region).
Room roles are inferred from furniture symbols, not labelled in the source.

East wall opening x-positions were derived from East_view.png's own dimension chain, not confirmed by explicit marks on the plan's east wall face; two openings (ED1, EW1) were clipped to fit plan-measured room boundaries since their elevation-derived spans crossed those boundaries.
Plan spaces were compiled deterministically from the declared footprint and physical partition segments; no snapping, extension, clipping, or inferred partition was applied.
unresolved: Fine sub-dimension chain sums did not exactly reconcile with outer brackets (e.g. 4060 vs 540+1500+2380=4420); outer-bracket/pixel-measured boundaries were trusted over the fine labels.
Exact sill/head heights for East and West facade openings not independently re-measured from elevation pixel dimensions; assumed equal to North window pattern.
The partial wall fragment near x440-560,y698 (south-east area) and its door are omitted from geometry; that zone is modeled as part of the merged corridor/open-office room instead.

East wall door/window positions were matched from East_view.png dimension chain rather than verified against explicit opening marks on the plan's east wall face; ED1 and EW1 spans were clipped at room boundaries rather than exactly matching the elevation-derived width.
Pixel-to-world calibration was supplied by the caller and was not independently verified.
